visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed hero with an autoplaying, muted, looping background video (poster image fallback), dark overlay, left-aligned headline, subheading and CTA, plus a pause/play toggle
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed 710px band with autoplay background video (bynder MP4, poster still), dark overlay, left-aligned white H1 (72px bold), subhead, green pill CTA, pause button bottom-right. Background belongs to the block, so no section metadata.

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: poster image and a link to the MP4 video (same cell or separate cells). Row 2: H1 title, subheading paragraph, CTA link (bold = primary pill button). The video link is removed from the visible content and played as the background; the poster image shows while the video loads and when reduced motion is preferred
contentPattern.description: Background video with poster image, H1 "Design an exterior you will love coming home to", subheading, CTA "Start your design" (/hardie-designer/) | Background MP4 video with poster fallback and pause control instead of a static image; left-aligned white text over dark overlay

usage: Use as the first block of a landing page when the source hero has a background video.
reuseGuidance: For a static image hero use the base hero block.
